recognize_zh: 這是臨床試驗設計示意圖（非形態學影像）：英國主導的低腫瘤負荷濾泡性淋巴瘤試驗，隨機分為 A 臂觀察等待、B 臂 rituximab 誘導 4 劑、C 臂誘導加維持治療，並標示規定的 CT 與骨髓 MRD 評估時間點。
features: Randomization into three arms displayed as timelines of clinic visits
Arm A: watch and wait with clinic visits only
Arm B: rituximab induction (four weekly doses, arrows at start)
Arm C: rituximab induction followed by repeated maintenance doses
Compulsory CT scans at defined time points, CT for clinical CR, and bone marrow histology/MRD only if CT shows CR
Progressive disease requiring therapy stops protocol treatment
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure is the schema of the UK-led randomized trial in asymptomatic low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma comparing watch and wait with single-agent rituximab. Patients were randomized to watch and wait (arm A), rituximab induction of four weekly doses (arm B), or rituximab induction followed by maintenance (arm C). Response assessment included compulsory CT scans at set intervals, with bone marrow histology and minimal residual disease testing performed only when CT showed complete response, and progression requiring therapy ended protocol treatment. The trial showed that rituximab delayed the need for new treatment, although an overall survival benefit was not demonstrated.
